'''June 2001 Centerville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Schumer's card store, Centerville, Ohio on 16 June 2001. It is known from Albert Klein's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2463">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-oh-6-16-01d2463/ centerville-oh-6-16-01], DeckTech (AJ "312" Klein, 16 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-oh-6-16-01d2463/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Schumer's card store, Centerville, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
